capture.method: Read-only GitHub connector GET /search/issues; sorted created ascending; per_page=100; all required pages retrieved.

interpretation: Open is the GitHub issue state, not proof that every item is unimplemented, technically blocked or a leaf.
Labels are copied verbatim and are not Project Status, Agent, Lease, formal readiness or authoritative claim evidence.
Work IDs are extracted from the sharpforge-backlog body marker, falling back to the title; no work ID is invented.
Pagination is not an atomic repository snapshot. Counts were stable across retrieved pages and all 311 issue identities are unique.
This snapshot does not assess acceptance completion or replace the separately retained prerequisite/owner handoffs.
